title: The Quiet Archive Revisited
author: Dominic Okafor
blurb: Cyrus Amberdale, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
